jingai mynsiem jong i, ba nga la pyrshang doli-im doh-'iap 
ban pynwan sha ka ktien khasi ia kato ka poem English, 
“An Elegy written in a Country Churchyard" ba la thoh da 
u Thomas Gray Jong ka /S"" century, England. Ka-tei ka 
poem ka la pynshoh ja-du ia bun ngut ki 'riew-khraw ka 
pyrthei, khamtam eh ia ki politicians wat kum ia ki jong u 
(late) Prof. G .G. Swell, kibaju bang bha ban quote ha ka 
jingkren paidbah jong ki. Ka stanza kaba 14, kaba ki ju 
bang ban kynud sur ka ong kumne: 

‘Full many a gem of purest ray serene. 

The dark unfathomed caves of ocean bear: 

Full many a flower is born to blush unseen 
And waste its sweetness on the desert air. 

‘Don kyrhai bah ki Main, ki larmoti, 

Ba thiah lyngngai ha trai du-riaw jylliew: 

Don kyrhai bah ki Tiewphuh-Jlop khlem ’/, 

Ba blad jingiew ha ri kynjah wei-briew.’ 

la mynta, ngam pat da kwah eh ban ong than ha-lor 
kane ka kam thoh poetry. Ka-ei kaba nga kwah ban ong ka 
long tang ban shu pynpaw ha ki nongpule ba-ieid jong ngi 
ia ka-ei kaba ka poetry ka trei, ka ktah, ka ktaid, ka shad

ta-wiar lyngba ki phang ba-pher ba-pher ka jingim briew 
bad kumno ka mih pyrthei. Ki 'riewpule ia ka English 
Literature, ki la tip bad sngewthuh ia kane ka phang. Ma 
ki ki la dep pule lut, kaei ka Poetry? Kaei ka kam jong ka? 
Kaei ka jing'iadei jong ka bad u Myllung, ne bad ka jingim 



u briew, ne bad ka pyrthei ne bad ka Im-lang ka Sah-lang 
jong ki ha bun ki Hang. Ki tip rub ia ka dur ka dar jong 
ka, ia ka rang ka rup, ka riam ka beit bad ia ki jait kyrteng 
ba-pher ba-pher jong ka. Ki tip nih ka-ei ka Jait subject 
ba ki poet ba-khraw Jong ka pyrthei salonsar, kum ki 
Greek, ki Roman, ki Italian bad ki English ki Jied ha kaba 
tbob Poetry. Ka Essay Jong u Mathew Arnold, “The choice 
of Subject in Poetry" ka ai Jingmut ia ngi 
shi-bun ha-lor kane ka phang. 

Ma ngi, ki khun khasi khara, nga lah ban ong , ba 
ngi long ka Jaitbynriew ba la kha lang bad ka poetry ha 
pneh ka Mei Mariang kaba pun ia ka. Ki Myllung khasi 
ba khain pawnam ki long, u Babu Soso Tham, u Rev. Fr. 
H. Elias SDB, u Bah S.J. Duncan, u Babu Victor G.Bareh 
bad u Bah Oscar M. Wahlang. Ki don ruh bun ki-wei pat 
ki Myllung khasi, kiba ha-dien Jong ki-tei bad kiba mynta, 
kiba don ia kata ka sap thoh poetry ha la ki Jong ki Jong 
ki kyrdan. Shi synpeit fa ki kot poetry khasi, la i kumba 
ki la bun shisha. Hynrei lada ngi phai pat sha ki thup. 
Jong ki poetry English ne bad ki-wei pat, ngi shem ba ma 
ngi ngi dang duna pa-lat. Kumba iohi bad shem da u 
Radbah Jong ka Jaitbynriew Khasi Jong ngi, U Dr. Radhon 
Sing Lyngdoh (bam kwai ha iing u Blei) uba ong kumne, 
ha ka Maitphang Jong u ia ka ‘Na Nengpei ki Sur Myllung' 
ba la thoh da u Bah B.C.Jyrwa: “Ka khasi Poetry ka la roi 
tang ha ka Hang ki Lyrics. Ha ka Hang ki Ballad ngi dang

don Jang lai tylli, ha ka Hang ki Ode ngi don tang kawei, 
ha ka Hang ki Elegy ngi dang don tang khyndiat eh, ha 



ka Hang ki Narrative Poetry tang lai ne saw tylli, ha ka 
hang ki Sonnet ngi dang don khadsaw tylli. Ngim pat don 
Epic-Poetry, ngim pat don wat ki Blank Verse ruh.” 

Haba sngap na ki-teiki jingkynthob jong u-tei u khlur 
ka Ri, ngi sngewthuh ba ngi dang duna bha ha ka Hang 
jong ka poetry. Bad dei kane kaba la pynlong ia nga ban 
i'ajngi lem ha ki thwei bajngum Jong ka thoh poetry. 

Nalor kata, ka kyntien ki ’riewstad ka pyrthei, bad 
khamtam eh, ki Jong u Swami Vivekannanda, ki ktah 
syndon trait ia ka ’mationg ki ’riewshemphang, haba u 
ong, ba ka long ka-ei ka-ei kaba Jah bu-rom bad kaba 
pynhiar kyrdan ia u briew lada ha ka Jingim Jong u um lah 
ban leb kano kano ka kam kaban sah dak ne sah nam ne 
kaban long ka Jingpyrto ia ki-wei pat ki para-briew 
ha-dien ha-bud. U briew u bym lah ban leh ei ei ha ka 
Jingim Jong u. ii long thik kum u maw ne kum ka dyngkhong 
pyut ki bym larkam ei ei shuh ha ka pyrthei. 

Ki-tei ki ktien Jong u Vivekannanda ruh ki tynrah 
Jur ia ka mynsiem Jong nga bad ki da kynthah ba-khor 
tyngeh ia ka Jingmut Jingpyrkbat Jong nga lada ngan shu 
pynkut noh ia ka Jingiaid lynti Jong nga ha kane ka pyrthei 
tang da kaba shu peit, shu pule, shu kynthoh bad shu 
bishar ia kiwei khlem da leh ei ei na ma-lade. Shi ru-kom, 
ngi kum ka Jaitbynriew Khasi, ngi dei ban sngew sarong, 
ba ki Longshuwa Manshuwa Jong ngi, ki la long kiba 
kham stad ban ia u Vivekannanda ha kane ka Hang. Na- 
mar ba shwa ba ma u un kren ki la dep leh ia ki kam bah

kam san ha la ka Jaitbynriew la jong. Ma ki, khlem bynnud 
ia ka par, ia ka bar la ka long ha ka met ne ka jingmut 
jingpyrkhat ne ha ka mynsiem, ki la tei ia ki Kor, ia ki 
Mawshongthait, ia ki Mawbynna bad Maw-nam 
Mawkyrteng ha man ki bynta jong ka ri jong ngi, ban sa- 
fe/?/ shynna ba ma ki kirn hun sa-tia ban shu i'eh-noh ia 
kane ka pyrthei sngi jong ki khlem da ioh leh kano kano 
ka kam ka ban long ka jingpyrto na ki Longdien Mandien 
jong ki. 

Ha kane ka Thup Poetry kaba mynta, ‘Ki Sur 
pangnud na krem Sha-dem', nga la pyrshang katba don la 
i bor ba-rit la jong ban tyrwa ha ki para ri ia ki jait poetry, 
kum ki Narrative poems, ki Odes, ki Elegy bad ki Sonnets. 
Phin shem ha ki ba ki phang-pdeng jong ki ki dei shaphang 
ka ‘jingieid,’ ba ngi ong ki ‘Love Poems’ ha ka ktien 
Phareng. Lehse, kane ka lah ban pynlyngngoh ia kiba bun 
ki nongpule, khamtam eh ia kiba dang khie dang san, 
lada ki tip ba iiba thoh u la dei u rangbahym u khynnah 
ne u samla. Hynrei kam long ka-ei ka-ei kaba phylla ne 
kaba khyllah. Ka jingieid ka mih na ka dohnud. Ka dohnud 
jong u briew kam long sa-tia kum ka dohnud u masi ne u 
sniang, kiba tang shu sah miet, ki lah sma. Pynban ka 
dohnud jong u briew ka iai rhem kat-ba ka nang slem ne 
kat-ba ka nang rangbah. Ngi lah ban ong ba ki poem kiba 
khraw tarn ha ka pyrthei kiba mih shisha naduh ka dohnud 
ki iai jyrngam sah katba ka dohnud briew ka dang im bad 
ka dang sah. Ki poet ba-khraw jong ka pyrthei, la ki Creek

ne ki Roman ne ki Italian ne ki English, ki shem ba ka 
‘Jingieid* ka long ka phang-pdeng kaba khraw tarn ha ka 
jingim briew. Ngi tip kumno u Dante ba-khraw jong ki 
Italian ka-tno u iam u lynniar na-mar kaba ‘leid'jong u,

kiwei pat, ba ka phang-pdeng jong ki ka long hi sha-

ha ka jingkmen ne ha ka jingiam pait dohnud dohnam 
jong ‘uba leid ia la kaba leid.’ 

Ka jingieid, namarkata, ka long ka tynrai bah jong 
ka dohnud briew kaba ktah ia ka dyngkhong jong ki 
jingsngew ba-roh; ia ka pyrkhat ka pyrdaih bad kaba 
saihdur wat ia ka iaid ka ieng jong u briew, Ki map jong 
ka pyrthei kumno ki kylla dur kha-ma-kha tang na-mar 
ba ki Syiem ba-khraw bor ki leit hiar thma ia ki-wei pat ki 
hima ne ki ri tang ban ioh ia ki thei bhabriew ban long ki 
mahadei jong ki. Kane ka long na-mar ba u briew u wad 
ia ka jingieid ha ka pyrthei. Ngi lah ban ong, ‘Love is 
beauty, beauty is love’. Katba u John Keats jong ki En- 
glish u ong, “Beauty is Truth, Truth beauty’’. Haba don 



ka jingieid, don ka jingitynnad, haba don ka jingitynnad, 
don ka jingieid.

Na-lor ki Narrative poems, bad ki Odes, nga la bsuh

leid Jaitbynriew’ ne ki kyoh mynthi ia ka long ka man, ka 
jingleb jingkam bad ka thong jong ki nong'falam ka Ri. 

Ha kaba ia-dei bad ka Rhyme Scheme, don ki Son- 
nets kiba iasyriem ia ki jong u Petrarch, don pat kiba ia- 
dei bad ki jong u Shakespeare, don ruh kiba ia-pher na ki. 
Ha ka jingshem jong nga, nga kham sngew ia-hap bad ki 
Rhyme Scheme jong it Shakespeare. 

Lyngba ki Sonnets, u poet u kham i'oh ka lad ban 
pyrta shnong kum u sangsot ha u khun ka ri shi tyllup 
ban hu-siar ha ka iaid ka ieng, ka kren ka khana, ka pyrkhat 
ka pyrdaih, ka trei ka ktah bad ka im ka iap jong ka 
Jaitbynriew.
